entities.name: First Talite Crusade
entities.description: Campaign of liberation by the Church of Tal after the Sylex Blast and the end of the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: Church whose followers, the Talites, marched against magic and machines.

entities.name: Raddic
entities.description: First leader of the Church of Tal.

entities.name: Monastery of Gix
entities.description: Gixian temple emptied by the crusade.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: Order that had mostly left for Phyrexia.

entities.name: Fallaji Empire
entities.description: Desert empire the crusade marched through.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: Ruined place the Talites cleared of artifacts.

entities.name: Korlis
entities.description: Land liberated from a cruel machine overlord.

entities.name: Penregon
entities.description: City with machines called civils, target of the Siege of Penregon.

entities.name: Siege of Penregon
entities.description: Siege that followed the Talite army reaching Penregon.

events.summary: The crusade purges the Gixian lands and empties the Monastery of Gix.
events.quote: The first crusade of the Church began with a purge of the Gixian lands to the far north of Terisiare

events.summary: The crusade marches through the old Fallaji Empire and the ruins of Kroog.
events.quote: The Talites then traveled through the ruins of Kroog

events.summary: The Talites liberate Korlis from a cruel machine overlord.
events.quote: the Talites liberated Korlis from this creature

events.summary: The Talites march to Penregon where planted agents await, leading to the Siege of Penregon.
events.quote: This led the way to the Siege of Penregon .

relations.quote: The Church of Tal banded together with Raddic as its first leader
